features: 1x 2.5G SFP port | 5x Gigabit LAN ports (including PoE-in (802.3af/at) on port #1 and PoE-out (Passive) on port #5) | 1x Full size USB 3.0 type A | 2 core CPU | Can be powered in 2 different ways (DC jack, PoE-IN) | RouterOS (Licence level 4)

Mikrotik E60iUGS, also known as the hEX S 2025, is a high-performance wired router designed for users who demand speed, flexibility, and value. Perfect for home labs, small offices, and advanced users, the Mikrotik E60iUGS offers a powerful feature set in a compact and cost-effective package.

Equipped with 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports, this router ensures fast, stable wired connectivity. Port #1 supports PoE-in, allowing you to power the device via a single cable, while port #5 supports PoE-out for powering other network devices like access points or IP cameras. The standout feature is the 2.5G SFP port, ideal for high-speed fiber connections or uplinks to switches — giving you future-proof performance.

Unlike standard ISP routers, the Mikrotik E60iUGS gives you full port configuration freedom. Assign any port as WAN, LAN, or bridge to match your exact network topology. With the powerful RouterOS v7, you get access to enterprise-grade features like advanced routing, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VLANs, bonding, traffic shaping, firewall rules, and more.

This model is engineered to handle modern networking demands while staying compact and energy-efficient. Upgrade your wired setup with the Mikrotik E60iUGS — the essential router for serious network builders.

Whether you’re creating a smart home backbone, managing a growing surveillance system, or running network experiments in a lab, the Mikrotik E60iUGS delivers the speed and control you need — without breaking the bank.
description: A compact, affordable wired router featuring a 2.5G SFP port, 5x Gigabit Ethernet, PoE out, USB, and a fast dual-core CPU – ideal for homes, offices, or underfunded labs that need reliable performance.
